articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Native Multimodal Reasoning and Extended Context
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning across text, image, audio, and video inputs with a context window exceeding 1 million tokens. The model demonstrates significant gains in long-horizon planning, mathematical proof generation, and agentic task completion, narrowing the gap on several benchmarks previously dominated by specialized systems.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics Models Enable Zero-Shot Manipulation in Unstructured Environments
articles.summary: DeepMind published results showing its Gemini-powered robotics foundation model can perform complex manipulation tasks — such as folding varied clothing items and assembling IKEA furniture components — without task-specific fine-tuning. The system leverages a vision-language-action architecture trained on a massive corpus of simulated and real-world interaction data, marking a step change in generalist robot capability.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces 'Constitutional Classifiers' to Harden Claude Against Jailbreaks
articles.summary: Anthropic detailed a new safety layer called Constitutional Classifiers that wraps its Claude models with input/output filters trained adversarially against thousands of jailbreak strategies. In red-team evaluations, the system reduced successful policy violations by over 90% while maintaining low false-positive rates on benign queries, setting a new benchmark for production-grade LLM safety.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Robots Begin Limited Deployment in Third-Party Warehouses
articles.summary: Tesla confirmed that its Optimus Gen-3 humanoid robots are now operating in pilot programs at select third-party logistics and warehousing facilities beyond Tesla's own factories. The robots handle bin picking, palletizing, and inventory scanning tasks, with Tesla reporting a target unit cost below $25,000 at scale — a price point that could reshape the economics of warehouse automation.

articles.title: Meta Releases Llama 4 Behemoth Open-Weight Model with MoE Architecture
articles.summary: Meta released the full weights of Llama 4 Behemoth, a massive mixture-of-experts model with over 2 trillion total parameters but only ~200B active per forward pass. The open-weight release includes a permissive license for commercial use and is already showing competitive performance with proprietary frontier models on reasoning and coding benchmarks, further intensifying the open-source AI ecosystem.

articles.title: ASML Reports Breakthroughs in High-NA EUV Yield, Clearing Path to Sub-1.4nm Chips
articles.summary: ASML disclosed that its high-numerical-aperture EUV lithography systems have reached production-viable yield rates at leading foundry partners, enabling chipmakers to push toward the 14-angstrom (1.4nm) node. The milestone addresses longstanding concerns about the economic feasibility of high-NA EUV and has implications for the next generation of AI accelerators and advanced SoCs.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance for Second-Generation Brain-Computer Interface Trial
articles.summary: Neuralink announced FDA approval to begin human trials of its N2 implant, which features double the electrode count of its first-generation device and a wireless data throughput exceeding 10 Mbps. The expanded trial will include patients with both spinal cord injuries and ALS, with early results from the first-gen cohort showing participants able to control robotic arms and software interfaces with high accuracy.

articles.title: Figure AI and BMW Scale Humanoid Robot Deployment Across Spartanburg Plant
articles.summary: Figure AI announced an expanded partnership with BMW to deploy its Figure 02 humanoid robots across multiple production lines at BMW's Spartanburg, South Carolina manufacturing facility. The robots now perform over a dozen distinct tasks including parts insertion, quality inspection, and inter-station transport, with Figure reporting a 3x improvement in autonomous uptime compared to its initial 2025 pilot.
